title: Exterior derivative of a scalar function times a constant covector
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, a : ℝ^P → ℝ, β a fixed m-covector on ℝ^P (β ∈ Covector (Euclid P) m), x ∈ ℝ^P with a differentiable at x, and w = (w₀, …, w_m) ∈ (ℝ^P)^{m+1}. Then the exterior derivative of the m-form y ↦ a(y)·β satisfies d(a·β)(x)(w) = Σ_{i=0}^{m} (−1)^i · (Da(x)wᵢ · β(Fin.removeNth i w)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (a : Euclid P → ℝ) (β : Covector (Euclid P) m) (x : Euclid P) (w : Fin (m + 1) → Euclid P), DifferentiableAt ℝ a x → exteriorDerivative (fun y => a y • β) x w = ∑ i : Fin (m + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i : ℕ) * (fderiv ℝ a x (w i) * β (i.removeNth w))
